name: Youtube Analytics
shortInfo: Understand user activity, video and channel performance.
brief: YouTube analytics tracks a variety of metrics at a channel, content and audience level.
about:
The YouTube Analytics Connector enables streaming relevant YouTube Analytics data into a user determined warehouse.

Check more about YouTube Analytics api documentation [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/youtube-analytics/index.html).
availableData:
[Custom Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/youtube-analytics/pipelines/custom-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve custom reports containing YouTube Analytics data.
